jpalermo – if trying to code the best way possible is a crime than keep it up. Many people will cheat in their code, if not for laziness than because they do not have the knowledge to nail down the code their working on. While sloppy code may run today, there is always tomorrow when it will not. While no person is always correct 100% of the time, and there may not be the “one and only” way to do things – there are always ways that things should never be done. Sloppy is just that.
Next time you are called a purist – just smile and say thank you to them. Good luck
